entities.summary: Martha Elizabeth Moxley was a 15-year-old American high school student from Greenwich, Connecticut, who was murdered in 1975. Moxley was last seen alive spending time at the home of the Skakel family, across the street from her home in Belle Haven. The case attracted worldwide publicity, as the Skakel children were nieces and nephews of Ethel Skakel Kennedy, the widow of United States Senator Robert F. Kennedy.
